items.title: CELEX:52026PC0560: Proposal for a COUNCIL DIRECTIVE amending Directives 2003/49/EC, 2009/133/EC, 2011/96/EU, (EU) 2016/1164, (EU)2017/1852, (EU) 2025/50 as regards the simplification of the Union framework on direct taxation and supporting growth and competitiveness of the EU
items.summary: This proposal aims to simplify the EU direct taxation framework to support growth and competitiveness by amending several existing directives, streamlining tax compliance for businesses operating across EU borders.
items.financeImpact: Potential reduction in cross-border tax compliance costs and administrative burdens, optimizing corporate tax structures within the EU.
items.action: Monitor the legislative progress of the proposal to assess future impacts on cross-border corporate tax planning.

items.title: CELEX:52026PC0308: Proposal for a COUNCIL DIRECTIVE on administrative cooperation in the field of taxation (recast)
items.summary: A proposal to recast the directive on administrative cooperation in taxation, aiming to strengthen tax transparency, information exchange, and cooperation among EU member states to combat tax evasion.
items.financeImpact: May increase reporting transparency requirements and compliance costs related to cross-border financial and tax data sharing.
items.action: Review internal tax reporting workflows to ensure readiness for enhanced EU-wide data sharing requirements.

items.title: CELEX:52026PC0502: Proposal for a REGULATION OF THE EUROPEAN PARLIAMENT AND OF THE COUNCIL establishing a framework of measures for strengthening Europe’s cloud and AI ecosystem (Cloud and AI Development Act)
items.summary: This proposed regulation establishes a framework to strengthen Europe's cloud and AI ecosystem, aiming to boost development, infrastructure, and adoption of AI and cloud technologies across the Union.
items.financeImpact: Potential access to EU funding, subsidies, or improved infrastructure, while aligning with new ecosystem standards may require compliance investment.
items.action: Track funding opportunities and technical standards arising from this Act to align product roadmap.
